article_title.ru: NVIDIA сменила руководителя, заявив о сохранении планов выпуска продукции
article_title.en: NVIDIA changes leadership while pledging to maintain its product plans
article_title.ja: NVIDIAが経営交代、製品計画の継続方針を示す

caption.ru: Смена руководства NVIDIA сама по себе не определяет судьбу вычислительных платформ, от которых зависят разработчики роботов. Обобщённая редакционная сцена: инженеры подключают и настраивают компьютер. Это не реальная лаборатория NVIDIA, не изображение конкретного продукта и не подтверждение исполнения обещаний совета директоров.
caption.en: NVIDIA’s leadership change does not by itself establish the future of the computing platforms on which robot developers depend. A generalized editorial scene shows engineers connecting and setting up a computer. It depicts neither an actual NVIDIA laboratory nor a particular product, and does not demonstrate delivery of the board’s commitments.
caption.ja: NVIDIAの経営交代だけで、ロボット開発者が依存する計算基盤の行方が決まるわけではない。技術者がコンピューターを接続し、設定する様子を一般化した編集イラスト。実在するNVIDIAの研究室や特定の製品を描いたものではなく、取締役会の約束が果たされたと示す場面でもない。

alt.ru: Чёрно-белая гравюра. Слева инженер в рабочей куртке подключает сетевой кабель к задней панели системного блока, придерживая корпус другой рукой и глядя на разъём. Кабель питания вставлен в отдельное нижнее гнездо. Справа её коллега в очках и свитере печатает на клавиатуре, глядя на монитор, повёрнутый экраном от зрителя. Оборудование устойчиво стоит на общем рабочем столе. Фон белый, надписей и логотипов нет.
alt.en: Black-and-white engraving. At left, a woman engineer in a work jacket connects a network cable to the back of a computer tower, steadying its housing with her other hand and watching the socket. A power cable occupies a separate lower inlet. At right, her male colleague in glasses and a sweater types while looking at a monitor whose screen faces away from the viewer. The equipment rests securely on a shared workbench against a white background, without text or logos.
alt.ja: 白黒の版画。左の作業着姿の女性技術者が、片手でコンピューターの筐体を支え、接続口を見ながら背面にネットワークケーブルを差している。下の別の接続口には電源ケーブルが付く。右では眼鏡とセーター姿の男性技術者が、画面をこちらに見せないモニターに向かってキーボードを操作する。装置は共通の作業台に安定して載り、背景は白い。文字やロゴはない。

visual_thesis: Корпоративная смена руководства и техническое состояние вычислительной платформы — разные уровни фактов. Один обобщённый эпизод инженерной работы подчёркивает зависимость робототехники от вычислительной инфраструктуры, не утверждая ни остановки продуктов NVIDIA, ни уже доказанной непрерывности их поддержки. Основание — статья nvidia-leadership; сюжеты других статей не используются.
visual_brief:
Use case: illustration-story. Produce exactly ONE original landscape 16:9 editorial illustration, black ink engraving on pure white, mid-twentieth-century Soviet popular-science printmaking language applied to contemporary engineering. Bold confident contours, solid black shapes, restrained disciplined hatching and crosshatching, generous white space, light faces and hands, readable at newspaper thumbnail size. No grey wash, sepia, tinted paper, colour, neon, frames, logos, lettering, charts, pseudo-interface, watermark or political symbols.

Single story: an editorial concept about engineers' dependence on computing platforms during a corporate leadership transition. The article concerns NVIDIA's change of leadership and its board's promise of continuity, NOT a measured robot experiment. Do NOT show executives, identifiable real people, a scandal, a particular GPU design, a claimed NVIDIA machine, a robot or an invented experiment. Depict generic ordinary engineering equipment, clearly an illustrative scene rather than reportage. Do not draw any outcomes or metrics.

Scene: two attractive, realistically proportioned adult technical specialists at a sturdy electronics workbench, with natural professional distance. One focused woman electrical engineer, in a practical plain work jacket with sleeves close to the wrists, sits/stands at the left end of the bench. Her concrete visible action is checking one physical connection: she firmly grips the plastic body of ONE standard small network plug and seats it into a matching visible socket on the rear panel of a closed unbranded desktop computing tower. The socket and plug must be clear and aligned. Her other hand rests safely on the solid tower housing to stabilize it, away from the socket. Her eyes follow this exact connection. Keep fingers normal, separated from the connector path, no penetration of solid surfaces. A short flexible cable leads from that plug down onto the tabletop and continues toward the back edge; its far end can exit the scene naturally. This is external cable connection only, no open chassis, exposed circuitry, invented tools or dangerous energized work.

At the right end, a calm male robotics software engineer with short hair, glasses and a simple knitted crewneck sweater is seated at the same bench, actively typing with both hands on a keyboard, looking at a modest modern flat monitor. Forearms and fingers make natural contact with keys; keyboard lies flat and within comfortable reach. His face is pleasant, dignified and concentrated, not posing. The woman and man do not touch or gaze at each other. The monitor is angled so its back and narrow side face the viewer, concealing all screen contents: no readable text and NO invented interface. One clearly attached monitor stand rests fully on the worktop. The tower is a separate solid box fully supported on the tabletop, safely clear of the man's hands. A minimal cable from monitor runs along the rear edge toward tower, without tangles or impossible branches.

Composition: mid-distance three-quarter view, enough of both specialists' faces and exact hand actions visible, all key points of support and contact legible. The woman's connection occupies the visual center; man's computer work completes a single coherent scene. The bench's top and structural legs are connected and stable. Equipment consists ONLY of the closed plain tower with few necessary ports, monitor, keyboard, necessary cables and simple seating. White wall/background with no poster. No rack of mystery devices, robot arm, diagrams, paper, clipboard, measuring tools or decorative knobs. Preserve visual economy: do not add a detail unless it explains an action. All objects obey gravity, correct scale and perspective. No floating objects or cables, no extra limbs, no implausible cable sockets, no connections to nowhere inside the main scene. The purpose must read as actual technical work on a computer system, with focused human agency, not romance or an office portrait.

Physical-consistency edit:
Edit this illustration with ONE small physical-consistency correction. Preserve the entire composition, the woman checking the network connector with one hand and stabilizing the closed tower with the other, the male engineer in glasses and sweater typing, faces, hands, monitor, bench, exactly the same black-and-white engraving and pure white background. Do not add people or change their poses. No text, logos, UI, poster or robot.
The computer's lower rear IEC power inlet is currently visibly empty while its operator types. Add ONE physically correct IEC female power connector seated fully into that exact lower rear power inlet (the little rectangular three-pin inlet near the bottom of the rear panel). Show only a modest black connector body covering the inlet and its cable extending naturally downward then supported across the tabletop toward the rear/left edge, continuing outside the frame toward power. No exposed pins, no electrical sparks or dangling plug. Keep this power cable distinct from the network cable the woman holds; do not join them into one cable or cross through her hand. Preserve her network connection unchanged. A cable can disappear behind the solid tower or bench edge by ordinary occlusion; it must not penetrate wood. The existing keyboard/monitor wiring can remain as drawn, passing behind the equipment. Add no decorative ports or hardware. This is an ordinary generic computer setup, not an exact reconstruction of a NVIDIA product or a claimed experiment. Maintain crisp mechanical contacts and newspaper legibility.
